# `network/chunks/FlowControl.js`

> **Source:** `engine/network/chunks/FlowControl.js`

network/chunks/FlowControl.js — credit-based flow control + priority lanes (network plan §28). QUIC-style: a receiver advertises how much in-flight data it can absorb; senders must reserve credit before sending and the receiver restores it once a fragment is verified/written.

## Functions

### `createFlowControl({ maxInFlightBytes = 16 * 1024 * 1024 } = {})`

Create a flow-control window.

### `tryReserveCredit(fc, bytes)`

Try to reserve `bytes` of send credit. Returns false (caller must pause) if it would exceed the window.

### `releaseCredit(fc, bytes)`

Restore credit after a fragment is verified/written (or dropped/timed out).

### `availableCredit(fc)`

Bytes of credit still available right now.

### `createPriorityQueue()`

Create an empty multi-lane priority queue.

### `enqueue(pq, lane, item)`

Enqueue an item on a priority lane (lower lane number = served first).

### `dequeue(pq)`

Dequeue the next item, always draining the lowest non-empty lane first.

### `isQueueEmpty(pq)`

True if every lane is empty.

## Constants

- `PRIORITY_LANE`
